decisions.reason: Close to the established core, the option remains valuable and cheap to keep while uncertainty resolves.
Distant from the established offer and still without positive signals, its option value is likely low and it consumes resources better used elsewhere.
Building on the established offer and expanded into a product line, it shows commitment and likely value.
The strong rental demand and large order signal that value is being realized, so the option is cheap to keep and likely valuable.
Early field usage reduces technical uncertainty and signals possible value, so the option is worth keeping open despite being distant.
